five_grounds.name: language and counterevidence
five_grounds.finding: SBYOR BA PO is an agent noun locally rendered one who undertakes, with the article and deed object outside. Its glossary deed is counterevidence to that literal glossary assignment, not reason to turn the agent into an object. GZHAN is the other person; its auto-aligned a bodhisattva is rejected. BYED/DU/JUG PA give do/to/get in the causative frame. GNYIS and GANG BYAS KYANG scope over equivalence; the English does-not-matter negative paraphrase supplies no separate Tibetan negation.
